pack.name: Clonedivers Forge
pack.notes: Clonedivers r25 (v2.2.1): Fixed custom Clone helmet/armor & walker LODGroup/MeshObject culling bounds in `patch_34` across all 5 performance tiers with 0 B `.gpu_resources`/`.stream` churn and 100% preserved GAR voices, 80/20 CIS Droids, skybox, and LEGO/Yoda runtime pins.
pack.statusNotes: Verified across all 5 tiers (full, lighter, reduced1024, reduced512, potato256) with 0 duplicate keys, 0 missing dependencies, 0 codec mismatches, and 100% unit_safe + runtime LEGO pins preserved.

textureProfiles.name: Full (Ultra)
textureProfiles.description: Original full-mip texture detail and full-resolution meshes.

textureProfiles.name: Balanced (Streamed)
textureProfiles.description: Full texture detail streamed on demand (-StreamFloor 512) to cut resident VRAM.

textureProfiles.name: 512px (Low / Deck)
textureProfiles.description: 512px texture cap (-StreamFloor 128) for low-VRAM GPUs and handhelds.

textureProfiles.name: 256px + Decimated Meshes (Ultra-Potato)
textureProfiles.description: 256px texture cap (-StreamFloor 64) plus vertex-compacted meshes preserving all 139 runtime-pinned LEGO/Yoda/TIE assets.
